== Notes ==
* This skill will render most targets ineffective, regardless of their profession or equipped skills.
* The short [[activation time]] of this skill means it can decrease the attribute rank of a skill that is being activated by a foe, making it an effective way to neutralize [[Dervish]] [[form]]s, [[summoned creature]]s, or various [[damage over time]] skills.
** Some skills are better to [[interrupt]], e.g. [[resurrection]] or [[No Attribute skill]]s.
** [[Renewal effect|Self-renewing skills]] will also be affected, if they renew themselves while this hex is active.
* This skill does not affect attributes boosted by an [[of the (Profession)]] mod.
